verdict.rationale: Hatchet supports local development via `hatchet worker dev` for local execution and `hatchet profile` for switching between separate named environments/tenants, which could be used to isolate a sandbox from production, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated sandbox/staging environment or test-data isolation feature. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-environment documentation, isolation guarantees between environments, and any hands-on confirmation that switching profiles avoids touching production data.
